title: Gaslight
description: A Scotland Yard detective (Joseph Cotten) figures out why a schizoid Victorian (Charles Boyer) is trying to drive his wife (Ingrid Bergman) mad.

title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
description: Angela Lansbury re-creates her Tony-winning performance of the opportunistic Mrs. Lovett, joining the macabre doings of the Demon Barber of Fleet Street, in Stephen Sondheim's Broadway musical.

title: The Brides of Dracula
description: Van Helsing (Peter Cushing) drives a stake through the heart of a vampire baron (David Peel) who even bites his own mother (Martita Hunt).

title: Blood From the Mummy's Tomb
description: An archaeologist (Andrew Keir) and his team bring back an embalmed Egyptian princess who takes over his daughter (Valerie Leon).

title: Dracula Has Risen From the Grave
description: The vampire count (Christopher Lee) bites a tavern waitress and a Monsignor's (Rupert Davies) niece (Veronica Carlson), then falls on something sharp.

title: Dracula A.D. 1972
description: Professor Van Helsing Jr. (Peter Cushing) protects his granddaughter (Stephanie Beacham) from the vampire count (Christopher Lee), brought back by London hippies.

title: The Curse of Frankenstein
description: The condemned baron (Peter Cushing) recalls making a mute monster (Christopher Lee) in his own image.

title: Horror of Dracula
description: Dr. Van Helsing (Peter Cushing) hunts the legendary king (Christopher Lee) of the vampires, who has left Transylvania for the blood-rich shores of England.

title: The Mummy
description: British archaeologists defile the tomb of an Egyptian princess (Yvonne Furneaux) and her buried-alive lover (Christopher Lee).

title: The Mystic
description: An American crook persuades a fake medium and her crew to set up shop in New York.

title: West of Zanzibar
description: A jungle ruler (Lon Chaney) lives to ruin the daughter (Mary Nolan) of the man who wronged him.

title: The Thirteenth Chair
description: A medium (Margaret Wycherly) holds a seance to clear her daughter (Leila Hyams) of murder in colonial India.

title: Mark of the Vampire
description: An elderly criminologist devises a unique scheme to unmask the killer behind a series of gruesome murders.

title: The Devil Doll
description: Paul (Lionel Barrymore) is wrongfully convicted of robbery and murder, and breaks out of prison using a scientist's shrinking invention.

title: Freaks
description: Sideshow performers punish acrobat Cleopatra (Olga Baclanova) for humiliating their friend, tiny Hans.

title: Becoming Hitchcock -- The Legacy of Blackmail
description: Highlighting the birth of the Hitchcock Touch at a period when talking pictures first emerged and exploring trademark themes like murder, suspense and blondes.

title: Blackmail
description: A Scotland Yard inspector (John Longden) deals with a blackmailer (Donald Calthrop) who knows that the lawman's fiancée (Anny Ondra) killed an artist.

title: The 39 Steps
description: Spies and the police chase a handcuffed couple (Robert Donat, Madeleine Carroll) who cannot stand each other.

title: Dial M for Murder
description: A husband's plot to murder his unfaithful wife goes awry in Alfred Hitchcock's adaptation of the Frederick Knott play.

title: North by Northwest
description: Mistaken identity spurs a foreign spy (James Mason) to pursue an innocent New Yorker (Cary Grant), all the way to Mount Rushmore.

title: Eva Marie Saint: Live From the TCM Classic Film Festival
description: An interview with Eve Marie Saint, concerning her life and career, taped at the TCM Classic Film Festival in April 2013.

title: Duck and Cover
description: Surviving a nuclear attack.

title: Godzilla
description: A fire-breathing behemoth terrorizes Japan after an atomic bomb awakens it from its centuries-old sleep.

title: Godzilla Raids Again
description: Prehistoric monsters Godzilla and Anguirus battle it out in Osaka, Japan.

title: The Lost City
description:
S01 E01 — Living Dead-Men
An evil scientist plots to take over the world after he invents a machine that causes earthquakes.

title: Dr. Gillespie's New Assistant
description: The doctor (Lionel Barrymore) has a Kansan (Van Johnson), an Australian and an Asian from Brooklyn to choose from.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Hyde and Go Tweet
Sylvester chases Tweety as he flies outside the office of Dr. Jekyll; Tweety ends up in the Hyde formula, transforming him into a giant.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Dr. Jerkyl's Hide
Sylvester Cat gets chased into Dr. Jekyll's lab by a pair of canines.

title: The Barkleys of Broadway
description: Half of a husband-and-wife dance team (Fred Astaire, Ginger Rogers) wants to be an actress, so they split up.

title: Lured
description: An American dancer (Lucille Ball) living in London helps Scotland Yard identify a murderer who preys on lonely women.

title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
description: Gentle Dr. Jekyll (Spencer Tracy) tests a serum on himself, releasing vicious alter-ego Mr. Hyde on 19th-century London. Prowling the town, Hyde ventures to a music hall and encounters Ivy (Ingrid Bergman), whom he takes forcibly as his mistress.

title: Soylent Green
description: Future New Yorkers live on a trademarked food, which two detectives (Charlton Heston, Edward G. Robinson) find has a secret ingredient.

title: Rear Window
description: Sitting in a wheelchair, his leg in a cast, a photographer (James Stewart) spies on courtyard neighbors and sees a murder.

title: Paper Moon
description: A 1930s con man (Ryan O'Neal) teams up with a precocious 9-year-old (Tatum O'Neal) who could be his daughter.

title: Chicago Syndicate
description: An accountant (Dennis O'Keefe) uses microfilm to nail a crime czar (Paul Stewart) for income-tax evasion.

title: Summer of '42
description: A teen (Gary Grimes) falls in love with a lonely young woman (Jennifer O'Neill) and hopes to take the place of her husband who is away at war.

title: Class of '44
description: Two friends (Gary Grimes, Jerry Houser) go to college and another (Oliver Conant) joins the Marines in this sequel to "Summer of '42."

title: MGM Parade Show
description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.

title: The Night Digger
description: A blind Englishwoman's (Pamela Brown) spinster daughter (Patricia Neal) hides a killer handyman (Nicholas Clay) at their gothic mansion.

title: Night Watch
description: The police and a neurotic woman's (Elizabeth Taylor) second husband (Laurence Harvey) do not believe she has seen a murder.

title: Chicago Syndicate
description: An accountant (Dennis O'Keefe) uses microfilm to nail a crime czar (Paul Stewart) for income-tax evasion.

title: Singin' in the Rain
description: A silent-film star (Gene Kelly) loves a chorus girl (Debbie Reynolds) who dubs his squeaky-voiced co-star in a 1927 Hollywood talkie.

title: To Be or Not to Be
description: Joseph and his acting troupe must confuse the Nazis and stop Professor Siletsky from handing over a list of Polish resistance members.

title: Night Song
description: A socialite (Merle Oberon) pretends to be poor and blind in her plan to help a blinded pianist (Dana Andrews).

title: Picnic at Hanging Rock
description: In turn-of-the-century Australia, three young schoolgirls wander away from a school picnic and become lost in the bush.

title: Witness for the Prosecution
description: An aging barrister (Charles Laughton) defends a man (Tyrone Power) for murder despite damaging testimony from the accused's wife (Marlene Dietrich).

title: Stage Fright
description: An English drama student (Jane Wyman) and her father help a young man (Richard Todd) accused of killing an actress's (Marlene Dietrich) husband.

title: The Unknown
description: A fugitive posing as a circus performer goes to extreme lengths to win the heart of his lovely assistant.

title: Day of Wrath
description: In 17th-century Denmark, a pastor's (Thorkild Roose) second wife (Lisbeth Movin) is accused of being a witch after falling in love with her stepson.

title: Ordet
description: Two sons of a Christian (Henrik Malberg) doubt their faith, while another (Preben Lerdorff Rye) believes he is Jesus Christ.

title: Gold Rush Maisie
description: Maisie hears about a gold rush just outside a town, and decides to go into business with a family of poor prospectors and a crotchety ranch owner who may be unknowingly sitting on a valuable vein of gold.

title: Maisie Gets Her Man
description: Maisie (Ann Sothern) falls on hard times and works at several odd jobs before she meets aspiring comedian Hap (Red Skelton).

title: The Barbarian
description: An Egyptian-American woman (Myrna Loy) runs around Cairo with a desert charmer (Ramon Novarro) who turns out to be a prince.
